## Goal / acceptance criteria
Test the SEC-125 behaviour of `freemyid monitor --previous`: malformed files (wrong types, huge numbers like 1e400, list-valued broker_id, bad dates, non-object entries, >2 MB file) never crash the command, bad values are dropped (never copied into the new report), and the 2 MB cap holds. Read `tests/test_monitor.py` and `tests/codex/test_cx_monitor_contract.py` first; cover only what they don't. Network is faked.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests must pass on Windows too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp` or POSIX-only paths. A real product bug = strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`. Check existing tests first (`tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/`) and don't duplicate a guard.
